network.title: You appear to be offline
network.body: We couldn't reach GOTCHA. Check your connection and try again.

timeout.title: That took too long
timeout.body: The request timed out before it finished.

cancelled.title: Request cancelled
cancelled.body: The request was stopped before it completed.

authorization.title: You don't have access
authorization.body: Ask a workspace admin if you need this.

tenant_inactive.title: This workspace is on hold
tenant_inactive.body: GOTCHA is paused for this workspace. An admin can restore access from billing.

validation.title: Check the highlighted fields
validation.body: Some values need correcting before this can be saved.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.body: This no longer exists, or it isn't visible in this workspace.

conflict.title: This changed while you were working
conflict.body: Reload to see the current version.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.body: Wait a moment before trying again.

integration.title: A connected service failed
integration.body: The problem is outside GOTCHA. Try again shortly.

server.title: Something went wrong on our side
server.body: We've been notified. Try again in a moment.

contract.title: Unexpected response
contract.body: We've been notified and are looking into it.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.body: Try again, or contact support if it keeps happening.

boundary.title: Something broke here
boundary.body: The rest of the app is still working.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.

TENANT_PLAN_REQUIRED.title: This workspace has no active plan
TENANT_PLAN_REQUIRED.body: Nothing is wrong on your side. Ask your GOTCHA contact to provision a plan for this organization.

TENANT_PAYMENT_REQUIRED.title: Waiting on payment
TENANT_PAYMENT_REQUIRED.body: Your plan activates as soon as the first payment is confirmed.

TENANT_SUSPENDED.title: This workspace is suspended
TENANT_SUSPENDED.body: Access is paused for the whole organization. Your GOTCHA contact can restore it.

TENANT_ADMIN_SETUP_REQUIRED.title: Setup isn't finished
TENANT_ADMIN_SETUP_REQUIRED.body: An admin needs to complete first-time setup before anyone can use GOTCHA.

TENANT_ONBOARDING_REQUIRED.title: Onboarding isn't finished
TENANT_ONBOARDING_REQUIRED.body: Connect your source-of-truth system to finish setting up this organization.

fallback.title: This workspace is on hold
fallback.body: GOTCHA is paused for this organization.
